episodes.name: The Mango
episodes.overview: Jerry shares George's self-doubt after Elaine admits not all was as it seemed during their romantic relationship.

episodes.name: The Puffy Shirt
episodes.overview: Jerry's appearance with Bryant Gumbel is not the expected career boost for Kramer's girlfriend; but George gets a new career after moving back with his parents.

episodes.name: The Glasses
episodes.overview: Kramer's optometrist pal replaces George's glasses with suspect frames.

episodes.name: The Sniffing Accountant
episodes.overview: Jerry thinks his accountant may be on drugs; George's passion wins him a job; Elaine's exclamations end her relationship.

episodes.name: The Bris
episodes.overview: Godparenting is a chore for Jerry and Elaine; tragedy befalls George's car; Kramer decries a genetic experiment.

episodes.name: The Lip Reader
episodes.overview: A tennis lineswoman is game to help George learn why he's been dumped.

episodes.name: The Non-Fat Yogurt
episodes.overview: Jerry and Elaine's suspicion about "nonfat" yogurt figures into New York City's mayoral race.

episodes.name: The Barber
episodes.overview: Jerry wants to switch barbers without hurting anyone's feelings; George goes to work, but was he hired?

episodes.name: The Masseuse
episodes.overview: Jerry's masseuse-girlfriend doesn't like George; Elaine's boyfriend shares a moniker with a mass murderer.

episodes.name: The Cigar Store Indian
episodes.overview: Reading TV Guide nets Elaine an admirer, but gets her into trouble with George's father; Jerry's gift to Elaine offends her friend.

episodes.name: The Conversion
episodes.overview: George wants to change religions for the sake of romance, while Kramer is attracted to a novice nun.

episodes.name: The Stall
episodes.overview: George is charmed by Elaine's new boyfriend; Kramer thinks Jerry's new girlfriend is his phone-sex mate.

episodes.name: The Dinner Party
episodes.overview: A "brief" stop to buy gifts for a dinner party becomes an ordeal thanks to George's big coat.

episodes.name: The Marine Biologist
episodes.overview: A writer hits a woman in the head with Elaine's electronic organiser; George lies to impress a woman.

episodes.name: The Pie
episodes.overview: A mannequin resembles Elaine; George battles for a bargain suit; Jerry wonders why his date won't try a pie; Kramer has an itch.

episodes.name: The Stand-In
episodes.overview: George postpones breaking up with his girlfriend; Kramer befriends a fellow soap-opera stand-in; and Jerry bombs trying to cheer up a sick friend.

episodes.name: The Wife
episodes.overview: Jerry's girlfriend poses as his wife to get in on his dry-cleaning discount.

episodes.name: The Raincoats (1)
episodes.overview: Kramer plans to profit from raincoats created by Jerry's dad; George sells his dad's old "cruisewear."

episodes.name: The Raincoats (2)
episodes.overview: The sale of Morty's raincoats is delayed; George tries to buy back his dad's clothes.

episodes.name: The Fire
episodes.overview: George embarrasses himself at a kids' birthday party; Jerry heckles back at a heckler.

episodes.name: The Hamptons
episodes.overview: In the Hamptons, George's date sunbathes topless; Kramer steals lobsters; and a handsome doctor compliments Elaine, or does he?

episodes.name: The Opposite
episodes.overview: George changes his life by going against his instincts; Kramer plugs his book on "Live with Regis and Kathie Lee."
